name: Typefully
tagline: Typefully is a distraction-free writing and scheduling tool for X (Twitter) and LinkedIn, with AI features that rewrite threads, suggest continuations, and analyse which posts drive the most followers and engagement. Its clean editor is optimised for long-form threads, and the analytics dashboard identifies your best-performing content formats. Creators and thought leaders building audiences on X use Typefully to write more consistently and with better results.
